Found and fixed two behaviour changes. Tests pass (517) and nothing is committed.

- **`src/discount.js`:** an unknown, truthy code now returns 0. `main` throws `unknown code: X`. I restored the throw, and a falsy code still returns 0.
- **`src/lineItems.js`:** the new `assertInt` call for qty used `min` 0, so `qty: 0` was accepted. `main` rejects it with `bad qty for …`. It is now `assertInt(qty, 1, …)`.

I compared every other source file against `main` with quote and semicolon style changes stripped out. The rest is behaviour-neutral: renames, arrow functions, `@example` docs, and the split into `money/round.js` and `money/format.js`. The FX and tax tables are unchanged.

`src/money.js` no longer exists, so any caller outside this repo that does `require('./money')` or `require('src/money')` will break. I left it alone because the split was part of the refactor. If you have external callers, say so and I'll add a re-export shim.
